title: 用户事件模拟

# 用户事件模拟 ## 核心概念 user-event 是一个模拟真实用户交互的库，比 fireEvent 更接近真实用户行为。它会触发完整的事件序列——例如 `type()` 会依次触发 focus、keydown、input、keyup 等事件，而 fireEvent 只触发单个事件。这使得 user-event 能捕获到 fireEvent 遗漏的集成问题。 ```mermaid graph TD A[用户交互测试] --> B{选择工具} B -->|推荐| C[user-event] B -->|特殊场景| D[fireEvent] C --> E[完整事件序列] C --> F[真实用户行为] C --> G[自动 focus 管理] D --> H[直接触发单事件] D --> I[scroll / drag 等] ``` | 交互类型 | user-event API | fireEvent 等价 | user-event 额外触发 | | -------- | ---------------------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------- | | 点击 | `user.click()` | `fireEvent.click()` | focus、pointerdown、mousedown | | 输入 | `user.type()` | `fireEvent.change()` | 逐字符 keydown、input、keyup | | 选择 | `user.selectOptions()` | `fireEvent.change()` | focus、click | | Tab | `user.tab()` | `fireEvent.keyDown()` | 自动焦点转移 | | 清空 | `user.clear()` | 手动操作 | selectAll + delete | ## 基础用法 ### 安装 ```bash npm install -D @testing-library/user-event ``` ### 设置 user ```typescript import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event' import LoginForm from './LoginForm' test('login form', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render() await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Email'), 'alice@example.com') await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Password'), 'password123') await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /login/i })) expect(screen.getByText('Welcome!')).toBeInTheDocument() }) ``` ## 常用事件 ### 点击 ```typescript import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event' import Button from './Button' test('click button', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() const handleClick = vi.fn() render() await user.click(screen.getByText('Click me')) expect(handleClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) }) test('double click', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() const handleDoubleClick = vi.fn() render(
Double click
) await user.dblClick(screen.getByText('Double click')) expect(handleDoubleClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) }) ``` ### 输入 ```typescript import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event' import SearchInput from './SearchInput' test('type into input', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render() const input = screen.getByLabelText('Search') await user.type(input, 'hello world') expect(input).toHaveValue('hello world') }) test('clear input', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render() const input = screen.getByLabelText('Search') await user.clear(input) expect(input).toHaveValue('') }) test('select all', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render() const input = screen.getByLabelText('Search') await user.click(input) await user.keyboard('{Control>}a{/Control}') expect(input).toHaveSelectionRange(0, 11) }) ``` ### 选择 ```typescript import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event' import Select from './Select' test('select option', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render( ) await user.selectOptions(screen.getByRole('combobox'), 'option1') expect(screen.getByRole('combobox')).toHaveValue('option1') }) ``` ### 上传文件 ```typescript import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event' import FileUpload from './FileUpload' test('upload file', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render() const file = new File(['hello'], 'hello.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }) const input = screen.getByLabelText('Upload file') await user.upload(input, file) expect(screen.getByText('File uploaded: hello.txt')).toBeInTheDocument() }) ``` ## 键盘事件 ```typescript import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event' import TodoApp from './TodoApp' test('add todo with Enter key', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render() const input = screen.getByLabelText('New todo') await user.type(input, 'Buy milk{Enter}') expect(screen.getByText('Buy milk')).toBeInTheDocument() }) test('navigate with Tab', async () => { const user = userEvent.setup() render() await user.tab() expect(screen.getByLabelText('Email')).toHaveFocus() await user.tab() expect(screen.getByLabelText('Password')).toHaveFocus() await user.tab() expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /login/i })).toHaveFocus() }) ``` ## user-event vs fireEvent | 特性 | user-event | fireEvent | | -------- | ------------------ | ------------------ | | 真实性 | 高（模拟真实用户） | 低（直接触发事件） | | 复杂性 | 高（处理多个事件） | 低（单个事件） | | 推荐场景 | 大多数情况 | 特殊情况 | ### ✅ 推荐使用 user-event ```typescript // 使用 user-event await user.type(input, 'hello'); await user.click(button); ``` ### 特殊情况使用 fireEvent ```typescript // 某些特殊场景需要 fireEvent fireEvent.scroll(container, { target: { scrollTop: 100 } }); fireEvent.drop(dropzone, { dataTransfer }); ``` ## 小结 ```mermaid mindmap root((用户事件模拟)) 核心 API user.click user.type user.selectOptions user.upload user.tab 键盘事件 Enter / Tab Ctrl+A 快捷键组合 对比 fireEvent 更真实 完整事件序列 自动 focus 最佳实践 优先 user-event 特殊场景用 fireEvent 始终 setup ``` - 优先使用 user-event，模拟完整的用户交互序列 - 支持点击、输入、选择、上传、键盘等全场景 - 始终使用 `userEvent.setup()` 初始化 - scroll、drag 等特殊场景使用 fireEvent
